how_these_runs_were_made: Each model was a fresh Claude Code subagent given one prompt with all the questions, told not to use tools, code, files or the web. The transcripts were checked afterwards: the only tool call in every run was the one that returns the answer to the caller (SubagentHandback). Run on 2026-11-07.
limits: All 40 GSTINs were put in one prompt, so the models could take care over each one. A single casual question in a chat may behave differently.
Only Claude models were tested here. Other models were not.
Subagents may think before answering; this is not the same as a short chat reply with thinking off.
Forty questions is a small sample. One mistake moves the score by 2.5 points.
